content.what_it_is: INPUT_READ is the input.txt parser module (L64-L303). A generic READ_FOUR_TYPE_VALUES interface dispatches integer, float, logical and string readers (L74-L79). Each typed reader checks file existence, scans for a named key via READ_VALUE, classifies the textual value with CHECK_CONSISTENCY_TYPE, then parses or assigns it (L85-L220). READ_VALUE repeatedly opens/rewinds unit 10, strips ! comments, splits the text at '=', and returns the first exact left-hand key match (L225-L262). CHECK_CONSISTENCY_TYPE classifies single T/F, numeric-character strings with/without a dot, and other strings (L264-L301).
entities: module FILE_EXIST L70, VAL_TYPE L71, VAL_READ L72

io.name: InputFileName existence checks in each typed reader
missing/type diagnostics to stdout and MPI termination on fatal errors

calls: MPI_FINALIZE+STOP on absent file/type mismatch L95-L96, L109-L110, L132-L133, L145-L146, L198-L199, L213-L214
unresolved: All four destination arguments are INTENT(OUT) (INTEGER_VAL L87, FLOAT_VAL L123, LOGICAL_VAL L158, STRING_VAL L190), but a missing key returns without assigning them at L100-L103, L137-L140, L172-L175 and L204-L207. Fortran makes an INTENT(OUT) actual argument undefined on entry, so callers cannot safely retain module initializers. This turns unchecked missing keys in io.f90—including WAVE_DATA_TYPE, ETA_LIMITER, NumberStations and the block of output flags—into undefined values rather than defaults.

READ_VALUE returns immediately on a match at L251-L253 without CLOSE(10); CLOSE occurs only on EOF at L258-L260. Successful reads leave unit 10 connected. Reopening/rewinding the same unit repeatedly may work for the same file, but switching InputFileName while connected is nonportable and the successful path never releases the unit.

CHECK_CONSISTENCY_TYPE calls a numeric string 'float' only if it contains a dot (L293-L299). Valid real inputs such as 1 or 1E-3 are classified INTEGER and rejected by READ_FLOAT at L142-L146, despite list-directed READ at L149 being able to convert them. Conversely malformed dot-containing numeric strings reach an unchecked internal READ failure.

Logical recognition accepts only a one-character uppercase T or F at L278-L282, and READ_LOGICAL sets true only when the first character is uppercase T at L182-L183. Lowercase t/f and standard .TRUE./.FALSE. forms are diagnosed as non-logical and then silently mapped false rather than rejected or parsed.

READ_VALUE computes FRONT=index(TEXT,'=') at L249 and immediately forms TEXT(1:FRONT-1) at L250 without a FRONT==0 branch. Blank/comment-only or arbitrary non-assignment lines therefore rely on compiler handling of a substring ending at -1 and can raise a bounds error under checking builds.
